messages:
ana: taking handoff for ongoing latency surge in embeddings (paging started earlier). summary: since ~7190010000 we've seen p99 token latency jump to ~3.2s in us-west-2 embedding worker pool. partial customer impact: a handful of enterprise customers reporting intermittent timeouts on bulk embed jobs. primary=ana (me), secondary=mattg. current mitigations: routing fallback enabled to eu-west for new requests, aggressive prefetch disabled, instance group scale-up to +2 nodes in progress. runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-p99

oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-EMB-LAT-7190. pages sent to @ana @mattg. auto-escalation in 20m. :rotating_light:

ana: latest observation: KV cache evictions spiked during burst; suspect hot-keying from a customer causing memory churn. telemetry: kv_evictions/us-west-2 = 4.1k/min, queue_depth=~120 -> causing backpressure and higher tail latency.

mattg: acknowledged. I'll take logs + trace. running quick query on shard assignment. if hot-keying, we should apply temporary per-customer rate-limit and move heavy tenant to secondary routing.

sasha: FYI I pushed a temp patch to reduce embed batch size from 512->256 on the worker pool (hope to lower memory usage). Deployed to canary 1/3 nodes, observing ~15% lower mem usage so far.

leo: adding to notes: customer-corp-A is high-volume; they've had 2 large bulk jobs in the last hour. I sent them a quick note (support ticket #SUP-8812) asking to throttle jobs.

ana: mitigation steps in progress (do not close):
- routing fallback active (new requests routed eu-west if compatible)
- scale-up +2 nodes requested, ETA ~7m
- reduce batch size (sasha) canary -> monitoring
- per-tenant emergency rate-limit (if hot-key confirmed) -> mattg action
- KV cache tuning: increase eviction threshold temporarily (if safe) -> pending verification

mattg: logs I pulled:
```
2026-03-15T03:11:22Z shard-23 kv_eviction=4123 queue_depth=118 tenant=customer-corp-A
2026-03-15T03:11:25Z worker-5 oom_kill=false mem_rss=11.2GB batch=512
```
looks like tenant correlation is strong. I'll open a temporary throttle for customer-corp-A and route them to secondary pool.

sasha: can confirm canary nodes show reduced OOM/headroom usage. no errors yet.

ana: customer impact summary for handoff: intermittent timeouts for bulk embed jobs for a small set of enterprise tenants (~3 customers). latency for typical single-embed calls unaffected for most customers. no SLO breach yet but risk is real.

oncall-bot: Pager update: INC-2026-EMB-LAT-7190 status=mitigating, severity=high, owners=ana,mattg, next-escalation=20m

ana: open action items for next shift (please accept if taking over):
1) verify scale-up completed and nodes healthy (link: https://redwood.internal/k8s/us-west-2)
2) confirm per-tenant throttle applied for customer-corp-A and monitor error rates
3) validate KV eviction threshold change is safe for long-run or revert
4) check routing fallback ratios and watch for eu-west cost/latency changes
5) keep support comms updated (leo)

mattg: will apply throttle and post exact command in thread, leaving note after done.

ana: handing off at 03:26Z. if you take over, reply with "I got it" and own the incident until resolved or transferred.

leo: I got it (monitoring support tickets and CS comms).

mattg: I got it for infra actions (applying throttle + verifying scale-up).

ana: thanks all. tagging runbook again: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-p99 and playbook snippet below for immediate actions:
```
# immediate
1) enable routing fallback
2) reduce batch size on canary, roll to fleet if stable
3) apply per-tenant throttle for identified hot tenants
4) scale up worker group + monitor kv_evictions
```

ana: leaving pager; ping me if escalation needed. end of handoff.
